title: Asahina Mafuyu — Super Exciting Three-Legged Race?〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Yeah, they're good...
They fit the song well.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Okay. I'll keep going in this direction.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Looks like we're in a good spot, so why don't we take a break?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Yeah, I agree. I feel like I've got sand in my eyes.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Great! I've been waiting to talk to you, Yuki!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I might make a school-theme music video one day, so I've gotta do some research. Unlike me, you actually go to school and stuff so...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So tell me what it was like? Was it fun?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh okay. So pretty standard stuff then?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Otori, is this a good pace?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! But I can still go a little faster!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Let's keep up this pace all the way!

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I was paired with a first-year student in the three-legged race...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Whoa, seriously?
Did you even know them?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line:
<I guess so...?
But she was a very strange girl...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Whenever my eyes met hers, she'd squeak or go pale and start trembling...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I don't think I ever had that effect on anyone else at school, so it felt kind of... New.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Huh. Maybe she was tense because you're older than her?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <If she was trembling, that's more than just being tense. It sounds like she was scared.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Oh... Well, I don't mind either way.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: (Maybe Otori sees me as something other than a goody two-shoes...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But that seems out of character for you, Yuki...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Amia asked you about the Sports Festival...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But it sounds like you really want to talk about this girl you keep mentioning.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Good work, Otori. I couldn't have won this without you, so thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <There could be something about this girl that you consider special, but just don't realize it yet.>
